dataFlow.entry: opencode: TemplateSelector.select(templateId) → Load requested template from TemplateRepository
dataFlow.decision: opencode: If template has candidates (A/B testing enabled) → Delegate to RPC API
dataFlow.sampling: rpc-api: select_variant_thompson_sampling() → (1) Find all variants, (2) For each variant: Load metrics (alpha, beta), (3) Sample from Beta(alpha, beta), (4) Select variant with highest sample
dataFlow.return: rpc-api: Return selected template with selection_metadata { method, alpha, beta, sample, variant }
dataFlow.handling: opencode: Receive response, load candidate if needed, fallback to stable on error
dataFlow.recording: opencode: Record selection decision to selectionHistory for metrics

responsibilities: HTTP client to RPC API for variant selection
Fallback handling (RPC failure, candidate load failure)

keyDesignDecisions.decision: Thompson Sampling delegated to RPC API
keyDesignDecisions.rationale: Architectural boundary: ML logic belongs in rpc-api, execution logic in opencode
keyDesignDecisions.impact: Clean separation of concerns, easier to test and maintain ML algorithms

keyDesignDecisions.decision: Fallback to stable on RPC failure
keyDesignDecisions.rationale: OpenCode should remain functional even if RPC API is unavailable
keyDesignDecisions.impact: Graceful degradation, no activity execution blocked by ML service downtime

keyDesignDecisions.rationale: OpenCode needs visibility into selection method for debugging and analytics
keyDesignDecisions.impact: Transparent decision-making, enables local metrics tracking

keyDesignDecisions.rationale: Backward compatibility during migration, clear guidance to use RPC API
keyDesignDecisions.impact: Smooth transition path, no breaking changes for existing code
